quarterly_data.quarter: Hitachi Energy press release: Hitachi Energy and Ansaldo Energia launch a strategic (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Ansaldo Energia: Hitachi Energy and Ansaldo Energia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to develop and market integrated power generation and electrification solutions, combining Ansaldo Energia's gas-turbine and generator technologies with Hitachi Energy's grid system integration (high-voltage, transformers, automation and power electronics), capable of serving both 60 Hz and 50 Hz markets, including deployment in data centers; the companies intend an end-to-end solution from power generation through the complete transmission system to the point of consumption (energy hubs, data centers, other large consumers). CEO Andreas Schierenbeck: 'Power demand is growing at a pace we have not seen for decades as the world enters the electricity era'; power demand continues to outpace available infrastructure.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (MoU for integrated power generation and grid solutions)
